outfit.name: 皇家荷叶边女仆装
outfit.prose: Royal Navy canonical maid dress: an elaborate dark navy-blue and snow-white lolita maid dress with ruffled lace collar, puffy shoulders, gold royal anchor pendant, white evening gloves with black ribbons, tiered frilled petticoat miniskirt, white thigh-high stockings with garter straps, and black patent strap mary janes
